context:
Goal: long sessions keep every ruling and detail when their context fills up.
Problem (rule): decision session-tiers says sessions rotate by usage but sets no limit; only you set it.
Based on (measured): cloud sessions get the same handoff checkpoints as local ones; in this triage session the usage checkpoint asked for a handoff rewrite 5 times, first at about 290k tokens, and after compaction the hooks asked again (transcript read, Nov 1 17:27 CST).
Based on (read): after compaction, the handoff is rewritten from the compaction summary plus a digest, not from full context; before compaction, it is written from full context. Autocompact starts at 384k of 500k.
Departs from: session-tiers sets no limit — a sets rotation at 70%; b records that no rotation limit is needed and compaction plus the handoff rewrite carries a session.

Your question, "is the missed handoff work because of cloud sessions?": no. The checkpoints and the after-compaction prompts fire in the cloud too (measured above). The miss was this session's own: after compaction it rewrote the handoff but did not read it back until a hook made it. That is a slip by the session, not a cloud gap, and a hook caught it.

lastAnswer.note: I lean towards B if it works and maybe somehow log to see if i should revisit this consideration.

options.gain: The handoff is written from full context, so nothing the summary drops is lost.
options.how: A session writes its handoff and a fresh session takes over at 350k of 500k, local or cloud.
options.label: Hand off at 70%, before compaction
options.lose: More fresh sessions, each re-reading its handoff and files.

options.gain: No rotations; it already worked once today.
options.how: Sessions run until autocompact; the compaction hooks make the session rewrite its handoff and go on, local or cloud.
options.label: No limit; let compaction and the handoff rewrite carry the session
options.lose: Detail the summary drops can be lost, and the session works from a summary after each compaction.

reply: Filed: no rotation limit, in the session-tiers record (draft PR #978). To revisit it, step compaction-carry-watch has each session name in its next report anything it had to recover after a summary; triage reads those lines and brings it back to you if losses repeat.
title: At what context fill does a session hand off to a fresh one?
why: Both work; a keeps full detail for the coordinator and triage, whose rulings must not drift. Pick b if fewer sessions matters more.
